notes.title: Shackles of Ellswyn - November Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42472183/4fd91ddb9cea652ed2baa10699d4b1625698d239.jpg[/img]
It's time for the Shackles of Ellswyn November update!

which comes with two main parts, the first and most obvious is that we're continuing onto the halloween content arc, which will conclude in December. 

The second part, is the new BishoujoMom cosplay content has now been added to the game, and the way that the content is unlocked has been changed. No Spoilers, but it's a little bit of an easter egg hunt! So good luck!

But as a way of making it a little bit easier, whenever you've unlocked a new gallery image for it, you will get a little notification pop up on screen, similar to the pop-up instructions.

notes.title: September Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42472183/b70182a797269b995a6c7862ed41b195c1218228.jpg[/img]

It's September Update time!
This one is a little later in the month, as things have been super busy, as we had three different artists working on pieces for the release.

Changelog:
-Credits are now only unskippable once.
-First part of the JOI update is now complete with a total of 50 unique JOI popups based on your configuration of toys and announcer.
-Maid outfit alternate route for gloryhole scenes
-Part 1 of the Witch ritual chamber scenes where the MC undergoes final feminization


We also have our second game already on Steam, which also receives monthly updates: Sleeve Shock!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42472183/a971c933a277995903147891a49e5080c015a2a9.jpg[/img]

Sleeve Shock updates at the beginning of the month, and Shackles of Ellswyn updates at the end of the month, and none of them have overlapping artists, so we're able to consistently keep both running at the same level.
The next update coming out introduces a never before seen character!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2499700/Sleeve_Shock/

notes.title: January Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42472183/dca999839d8bc49f9bb15b22241ad025cffb8a9b.jpg[/img]

Our previous release style had felt like adding new pages to a comic book, where we just tack on the next set of art and write a little bit of story, which worked well for starting out but we're at a place where it's going to get more complicated and interwoven and things will start to overlap and make less sense, and that would ruin the immersive attention to detail and world building that we've been dedicated to.
A lot of time was spent combing back through what exists now, and finding ways to make that it will seamless flow with the future planned content, so that for example; meeting the Queen and the Witch in any order doesn't affect the story in any way, and their different storylines are more easily defined beyond colour coding (Queen: Submission, service, Witch: Feminization, Breeding)
We're now currently in the planning stages of the next update, where we can finally get our third major character voice acted which will hopefully balance out into a major audio update for a smoother overall experience.

Changelog
-Gallery updated to include all full screen art present in the game.
-fixed splash sequence to smoother transition to menu
-added a new main menu for when you finish the game
-added a big conversation section where you get to learn more about the queen and her backstory.
-tidied up credits
-added Itch.io button / Black Contract spot
-Major rerouting for flexibility in storyline (Handles the order in which you meet the queen or the witch better) and fixes a sequence break.


Next patch:
-audio overhaul, more voicelines, new Jane voice acting, and music adjustments.
-More JOI added and balanced
-added a big conversation section where you get to learn more about the warrior and her backstory.

notes.title: August Update: Queen Content
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42472183/66a40c65153d1775b0418a77acab59d4538851f6.jpg[/img]

The August update is now here!

To expand on the Queen's route, we wanted to go back and change some of the existing art to match, not only the new background art, but also the different direction of the scene, and it is now much smoother and more engaging. We've done lots of other little upgrades that might not be super obvious, but were a necessary stepping stone to keep the game at its high quality!




Changelog:
-adjusted some routing and continuity errors
-replaced art and expanded initial queen cage scene
-replaced and upgraded lots of minor art assets
-Expanded intro to include cinematic castle shot
-updated intro splash to have new animation

-added first round of witch voice acting

-Added first segment of witch arc content
